EYEOTA MOVING-LETTER EYE TEST — WORK IN PROGRESS
This research/development project explores whether a circular moving-letter interface may be useful for vision testing. It is not a medical device, clinic, diagnosis, prescription, or substitute for an examination by a licensed eye-care professional. The creator is not a doctor or clinic. Prototype results must not be interpreted as a medical diagnosis.

WORK IN PROGRESS — EYEOTA Music Lock is an evolving prototype rooted in a rhyme dial I began developing when I was young, around ages 20–23, while in jail for something minor. I was writing raps and struggling to find rhyming words without a dictionary, so I traced a circle using my cup and arranged the alphabet around it. That dial helped me cycle through letters, explore words, and identify rhyme patterns. People familiar with my early work saw the concept during that period. Around the same time, a family member helped me create shirts featuring the EYEOTA logo and some of my early concepts.

Years later, encountering circular designs in publicly released creative work and hearing faith-centered music renewed my motivation when I was close to giving up on my ideas. When I heard that music, I was going through what felt like the worst time of my life, which made its message especially meaningful to me. I personally experienced this as encouragement from God to keep creating.

EYEOTA’s early concepts were developed independently. Later sources of inspiration encouraged me to continue that work; they were not the origin of those concepts. This project does not claim affiliation with or endorsement by the creators whose work inspired me.

CONCEPT • IN DEVELOPMENT

EYEOTA Desktop

EYEOTA Desktop is a music-driven desktop environment being developed around EYEOTA's circular interface. The rotating dial is envisioned as a launcher for applications, games, files, system tools and EYEOTA's own internet experience.

MUSICAL CIPHER

CURRENT CHARACTER READY

Your normal keyboard. A musical message. A dial that follows every character.

Your typing appears as notes. Click Read my typing to see the original text. No copying between boxes is needed.

Type a message, then click Read my typing.

Verified access: lock or reopen a saved message

To protect your typing: enter a password, click Lock my message, then save it. To reopen it: load the saved file or paste its locked notes, enter the same password, then click Unlock saved message.

Live typing notes disguise text. Lock my message encrypts it with your password and clears the draft. Locking and unlocking send your message and password to your EYEOTA server over HTTPS. These routes do not save them. Save your locked message before closing. There is no password recovery. Prototype: use test messages until reviewed.

A Personal Apology

Several years ago, during a period of serious personal hardship and mental health difficulties, I sent emails to public figures and others that included offensive and inappropriate language. I sincerely apologize to those who received them. Those circumstances help explain what I was experiencing, but they do not excuse the way I communicated. I regret my words and am committed to sharing my ideas with respect and care.
